correctness.rationale: For arbitrary origin-interior factors, classify each product ridge: within a factor its conductance and mass scale by complementary volumes; cross-factor ridges have conductance m_ia*m_jb times all remaining volumes. The pyramid identity sum_a m_ia=d_i V_i makes the mass-mean-zero block spaces invariant with factor spectrum shifted by n-d_i. Block-constant functions have eigenvalues 0 (one) and n (r-1); dimensions exhaust facets. Antipodal involution preserves blocks, and the regular-polygon cycle Fourier diagonalization gives even levels 4 cos^2(pi/N), proving λ1,e=n and multiplicity r-1+#square factors. Independently constructed the 10-by-10 mass-weighted square–hexagon operator, checked weighted symmetry and constant eigenvector, and obtained eigenvalues 0(1), 3(4), 4(2), 5(2), 6(1) exactly. This finite example corroborates but is not the all-product proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Hu–Ivaki Theorem 1.1 is a conditional local-minimizer lower bound, not an exact spectrum theorem for arbitrary products; generic rank-one graph perturbation arguments start only after the geometric join weights are known.
